mapper.sql: select g.grant_id, g.member_id, m.phone, g.level_id, g.level_name, g.cycle_key, g.grant_cycle, g.grant_mode, g.currency, g.amount, g.status, g.pay_by, g.pay_time, g.create_time, g.remark from biz_level_reward_grant g left join biz_member m on m.member_id = g.member_id
mapper.select: where g.member_id = #{memberId} and g.level_id = #{levelId} and g.cycle_key = #{cycleKey} limit 1
select count(1) from biz_level_reward_grant where member_id = #{memberId} and level_id = #{levelId} and status in ('0', '1')
